# secureaccess_content_category_list (Data Source)

This data source reads the Content Category List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_content_category_list" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Content Category List

### Read-Only

- `is_default` (Boolean) Indicates if the Content Category List is the default one
- `type` (String) Type of the Content Category List
